name: beads
description: Organization policy for Beads (bd): persistent task scope, atomic claims, field and metadata conventions, actor identity, JSON envelopes, and authority-aware Dolt sync. Ships a PreToolUse guard denying mutating `gh issue` commands in beads repos and a concise dual-runtime subagent claim and handoff contract. The bd CLI owns `bd init`, `bd setup`, native Claude and Codex lifecycle hooks, generated instruction blocks and skills, and the Git hook bundle; this package does not render copies of those integrations. Requires gastownhall/beads >= 1.1.0; policy surfaces are inert outside a Beads workspace.
